KHET — KALA PANI

Eau de Parfum (50 ml EDP) — An oceanic olfactory architecture of tidal salinity, crushed black pepper, wet pelargonium, and smoldering amber pine.

CLIENT Khet Parfums
DISCIPLINE Haute Parfumerie · 4K Cinema & Stills
PACKAGE Flagship Campaign Production
YEAR 2026

Kala Pani is the scent of rebellion.

It is cooling, liberating, and powerful — a perfume that carries the weight of stories untold and the thrill of breaking boundaries.

Commissioned by Khet Parfums, Kriyon Media directed and produced the flagship commercial campaign suite: a 4K vertical cinema commercial capturing fluid dynamics and surface tension, alongside ultra-high-resolution macro, flatlay, and oceanic landscape stills engineered for digital flagships, print editorial, and luxury retail.

FRAGRANCE NOTES
  • Top: Black Pepper, Sea Water
  • Middle: Seaweed, Geranium
  • Base: Amber, Pine
CULTURAL REFERENCE

The elemental legend of Kala Pani (Black Waters) — reimagined as modern oceanic rebellion and sovereign liberation.

OCCASION

Evening wear, high-impact signatures, and avant-garde editorial presence.

VIBE

Cooling, liberating, rebellious luxury, and dark marine salinity.

PRODUCTION

Commissioned Commercial Campaign Suite & 4K Cinema Commercial directed & produced by Kriyon Media.
